reason: The README clearly describes an agent bridge for inspecting, editing, and rendering local Timeline Studio video projects, with project mutation and filesystem-backed media operations.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Timeline Studio，用于检查、预览、编辑本地时间线项目并渲染 MP4。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Timeline Studio to inspect, preview, edit local timeline projects, and render MP4 files.

capabilities: Creates versioned edit plans and computes project diffs
Renders edited projects to MP4 using Timeline Studio and FFmpeg
Reads and writes files within configured allowed roots
Invokes a Timeline Studio child process
